title: dont split phone ssn card
rule: Do not split phone, SSN, or credit-card numbers into separate fields. One input; segmented fields force meaningless labels for AT. Distinct from GOV.UK three-field dates.
pass_when: Phone, SSN, and card number are each one field.
fail_when: Those numbers are split across multiple fields.
overview: Phone, SSN, and credit-card numbers each use one field, not segmented inputs.
apply_when: Collecting phone, Social Security, or payment-card numbers in a form.
not_when: GOV.UK-style three-field memorable dates, which are a different pattern.
agent_hint: Keep phone, SSN, and card numbers in one field each; do not segment them.
description: USWDS keeps phone, SSN, and credit-card numbers in one input each so assistive technology gets a meaningful label and users paste or autofill without hopping boxes. Segmented fields force meaningless part labels and break common entry habits. This is distinct from GOV.UK three-field memorable dates. Splitting those numbers across multiple boxes fails; use a single field per number type.
do_not_claim: Memorable date three fields as this row; input-mask (skipped as NN/g).
